name: 几何扁平
description: 圆弧与多边形有序拼接，少量柔和渐变使二维几何形象清晰而灵活。
rendering_prompt: Reorganize the subject into clear geometric units such as circles, arcs, and polygons, compressing complex contours and details into orderly flat shapes. Use a concise, harmonious palette, with extremely restrained smooth gradients in selected fields. Convey layers through adjoining shapes, overlap, and color differences. Retain key identifying features and a two-dimensional design character. Avoid realistic textures and heavy perspective-based volume.
avoid: 写实纹理、厚重透视、随机几何装饰
difference: 几何扁平允许丰富配色；包豪斯更强调原色与功能秩序
tuning: 用少量几何单元重建可辨识轮廓，避免只在照片上叠形状。
